Naigamas
(‘those [who accept the authority of] the वेदस्’)
------------------------------------------
Some sections of the śaivas—followers of शिव and Śaivism—who accept the authority of the Nigamas or the वेदस्, like the Pāśupatas, are sometimes called ‘Naigamas’.
‘Naigama’ also means the उपनिषद्स् (Vedānta) and a section of the Vedic dictionary called Nighaṇṭu.
